name: Volu
desc:
Volu is a Capra NPC. He is affiliated with [The Ministry](faction:the_ministry).

Upon initiating dialogue, he will desperately try to hand you the first volume of the Strange Tomes. Upon gathering all 3 of them, you can place them in the pedestal next to him to obtain the Bloodfouler.
additional_info:
-   Volu has a Resonance with an unknown ability.
    -   The Resonance is gray and Stony in texture.
